infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: ClubPulse reads your step count from Apple Health so you can earn Scores for staying active.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: ClubPulse uses your phone's motion sensors to count your daily steps and reward you with Scores.
